alternative_explanations: The v1 gain may require two macro uses and disappear on one-use tasks.
Global MDL frequency may select a competing fragment as irrelevant programs grow.
Grammar ordering rather than transferable abstraction may explain part of the operation reduction.
confounds: Program length remains supplied to every solver.
The DSL and primitive permutations remain hand-provided.
The visible synthetic benchmark cannot establish open-domain transfer.
falsification_criteria: Learned-library accuracy is below primitive-only accuracy or any seed loses exact held-out behavior.
Correct macro selection occurs in fewer than 8 of 9 seed-by-K corpora.
At K=128 the learned candidate fails to reduce amortized cold operations by 30 percent at both D=4 and D=6.
Across D=4/6/8 the learned candidate is slower than primitive search on average or the mismatch control reproduces its gain.

outcome_policy.negative: Failure under competing fragments or irrelevant programs identifies EXP-0007 as a clean-corpus artifact for this extractor; reduce confidence and preserve both outcomes.
outcome_policy.null: The clean v1 effect replicates only under dense reuse or small K, so HYP-0002 remains testing and this extractor is not exploited further.
outcome_policy.positive: A robust screen result supports reusable library search under bounded distractors and justifies a new task-family transfer test, subject to the Pareto gate.

predicted_outcome: The unchanged extractor will select (0,1) in at least 8 of 9 seed-by-K corpora, preserve exact held-out accuracy, and reduce amortized cold operations by at least 30 percent versus primitive search at D=4/6; D=8 may be neutral when the macro appears only once, while mismatch will not reproduce the average gain.
promotion_criteria: Promising requires all three seeds, correct selection in at least 8 of 9 corpora, exact accuracy, at least 30 percent amortized reduction at D=4/6, seed CV at most 0.10, and inclusion on the declared accuracy-gated Pareto frontier.
research_question: Does the EXP-0007 learned-library search advantage survive three seeds, competing frequent fragments, irrelevant solved programs, and held-out tasks where the useful macro appears only once or twice?
title: Adversarial multi-seed replication of induced program libraries
